name: Spell Sniper
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Bypass Cover.description: Your attack rolls for spells ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

Casting in Melee.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells.

Increased Range.description: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.
